agency.name: Guam Behavioral Health and Wellness Center (GBHWC)

narrNote: No Guam affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched and read in-run 2026-10-22). Left null — never inferred.
notes: GBHWC is Guam's designated behavioral health agency (formerly the Department of Mental Health and Substance Abuse); its official site rendered in-run describing CARF-accredited mental health and substance use services. Agency phone left null: no main office number was confirmed on the official site in-run (the actionable published number is the 24/7 crisis hotline). The crisis hotline number (671) 647-8833 is published in Government of Guam Joint Information Center releases; GBHWC also operates Guam's 988 contact center. two11 null: no 211 information-and-referral service was identified for Guam in-run. peerOrgs empty: the Oasis Empowerment Center provides women-focused recovery services on Guam, but no official website for it could be verified in-run (only third-party directory listings), so no URL is published. medicaidSud URL is the Guam Department of Public Health and Social Services site (fetched 200); Guam Medicaid is administered by DPHSS (Division of Public Welfare / Bureau of Health Care Financing Administration). countyDirectory null: Guam is a single island jurisdiction and GBHWC is the territory-wide provider.
